newsitem.title: USA: Fidelity cuts expenses on index funds.
newsitem.headline: Fidelity cuts expenses on index funds.

text.p: Fidelity Investments said it has cut its expense ratios on two of its S&P500 index funds to among the lowest in the industry.
The change, which takes effect on April 18, cuts the expense ratio on Spartan Market Index Fund -- renamed from Fidelity Market Index Fund -- by 58 percent to 19 basis points from 45 basis points.
The expens cap on Spartan U.S. Equity Index Fund -- formerly Fidelity U.S. Equity Index Portfolio -- was cut 32 percent to 19 basis points from 28 basis points.
The expense ratio cuts are guaranteed through December 31, 1999.
